up: List the molecules reported in document CHEMBL2176942. Return the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Order the results by the ChEMBL identifier.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2176942' ORDER BY md.chembl_id
